activity_summary: After morning prayer Master Thwaite would not put a feast into a book that does not have one. He had kept yesterday's sermon to one glass, and he would not say it again. Mistress Ansell left Saturday's supper where it was. Sir John Spencer sat his pew without a sword-bearer. You did not go to the gate. Dinner at her table is threepence. You did not start the tomb.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Agreed the almanac was blank, and left the vault for another day.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Refused a second sermon, and named dinner at threepence.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Held to yesterday's one glass, and would not write a feast in.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Left the Monday ink for Monday, and set three trenchers.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat his pew. He did not speak, and no sword-bearer stood behind him.

facets.activity: Stood through morning prayer and went in to dinner

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: There is no feast in the book today.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: You will eat. It is short of the notch, and it is a penny, and I am not opening a baker on a Sunday.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: There is no play today. I am not going up the lane.
